property_summary: For every call to fallback with msg.value == 10 ether and block.timestamp > pastBlockTime, the reference contract always updates pastBlockTime to the current block.timestamp (so subsequent getter pastBlockTime equals the timestamp at the call), whereas the mutant omits this update and thus fails to change pastBlockTime for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the update to pastBlockTime (delete assignment), so fallback no longer changes that state variable.
